lots.guide_summary: All 6 surviving entries are SOLD hammer prices at Gowans for RAM 1oz silver Kangaroo series $1 coins (uncirculated or frosted, not proof): $79 to $160, 2026 sales $100 to $160, latest $125 (Sep 2026). None is the 2023 Mob of Thirty proof itself, so they are a floor for a 1oz RAM kangaroo, not its proof value. No unsold or asking evidence. All AUD, no FX. Silver spot today A$86.69 ask / A$84.64 bid per oz (Perth Mint, 7 Oct 2026); melt about A$85, Perth Mint buys 1oz coins at A$80.41.
lots.working: Keep: lowest surviving close SOLD in 24 months = $79 (2004 frosted 1oz Kangaroo, listed 2025-11-10). 79 / 1.198 = 65.94, round down to $65 (all-in $77.87, a little under melt, so very safe but may not win; the coin already has 3 bids). Flip: likely resale about $110 as a 1oz RAM kangaroo (2026 hammers $100-160; proof premium not evidenced); less 13% marketplace and payment fees ($14.30) and $12 tracked postage = $83.70; / 2.396 = $34.93, round down to $30. Pickup Moonah, inbound freight $0. These maximums treat the coin as a 1oz RAM kangaroo floor; any proof or mintage premium is unproven upside.

lots.dropped_entries: Dropped all 3 researcher entries. (1) 2025 'C' mintmark $1 fine silver proof $55 (lot 370081): opened its photos, certificate shows 11.66g, 25.00mm (60th Anniversary RAM), not 1oz, so not comparable. (2) 2016 Canberra 'C' mintmark $1 fine silver proof $65 (lot 375165): photos show a small coin (about 25mm, 'Australia's First Mints'), not 1oz. (3) 2025 C mintmark coloured WWII proof $200 (lot 385390): certificate shows $2, 8.55g, 20.50mm, mintage 10,000, a different and collector-driven coin. All three prices and dates were correctly read; they were dropped as different items. Replaced with Gowans 1oz RAM Kangaroo series sales from the 'kangaroo silver' search.
